name: Ipp Simple Loading
author: johnguaz

sections.description:
Add loading screens to your beautiful WordPress websites

FEATURES & OPTIONS

  • Different Loader types in css3 animation where you can customize the size and color
  • Customizable background colors
  • Animated background effects with configurable accent and base colors
  • Background image with size, repeat and blend mode options
  • Option to add your logo in the loading screen
  • Option to add text, custom HTML and an exit button for your loading screen
  • Option to choose which published pages and public post types to show the loading screen
  • Option to show the loading screen on all devices, desktop only or mobile only
  • Option to add entrance and exit animation for your loading screen
  • Maximum timeout so the loading screen always closes, even if a page stalls
sections.faq:
Changes not reflecting

Make sure you have saved the setting and if you have installed any caching plugins then kindly clear the cache.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial Released

1.0.1

  • Use rest_route instead of wp-json to handle none pretty permalink setup

1.0.2

  • prevent body scroll while loading page
  • improve exit button icon

2.0.0

  • make prevent body scroll while loading page configurable
  • Add optional background effect warpspeed
  • Add optional background effect squares
  • Add optional background effect waves
  • Add optional background effect grid
  • Add optional background effect ripple
  • Add optional background effect diagonal

2.1.0

  • Add new property and option to change background effect colors

2.2.0

  • Add background image configuration

2.2.1

  • bugfix on none logo animation

2.2.2

  • 6.9 testing compatibility

2.3.0

  • Add new loaders: dots, hourglass, dna, ring and blob
  • Add new background effects: matrix, aurora, bubbles, geometric, fireflies, neon lines, constellation and hex grid
  • Add separate accent and base colors for background effects
  • Add device targeting (all devices, desktop only or mobile only)
  • Add custom HTML option for the loading screen
  • Add maximum timeout option so the loading screen always closes
  • Rework the settings screen with a visual loader and background effect picker
  • Fix warpspeed background effect rendering incorrectly on high-DPI screens
  • Harden settings against missing/partial saved data (no more PHP notices or JS crashes on upgrade)
  • Clamp max timeout and custom HTML length on the server side as well as the client side
  • Bust cached admin/public CSS and JS on upgrade via a real plugin version string
  • Accessibility improvements to the settings screen (button roles, aria attributes)

2.3.1

  • Fix waves background effect not animating
